verdicts.reason: A drops the SOLSTICE wordmark from the top and wedges it between headline and body copy, so it competes with the headline. The block of headline, wordmark, body and CTA is cramped while the top of the canvas sits empty, and the body copy runs over the yellow circle. B keeps the original order (logo, can, headline, copy, CTA) with even spacing; its only flaw is the body copy grazing the yellow circle, as in the original.
